title: Burst Balloons
inputFormat: Implement maxCoins(nums), where nums lists balloon values in their initial left-to-right order.
outputFormat: The maximum total coins after bursting every balloon. Missing neighbors contribute 1; neighbors change after each burst.

visuals.title: Neighbors change after each burst
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 225" role="img" aria-label="An optimal order earns 15, 120, 24, and 8 coins for a total of 167" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><text x="16" y="30" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="17">[3, 1, 5, 8]  burst 1: +15</text><text x="16" y="68" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="17">[3,    5, 8]  burst 5: +120</text><text x="16" y="106" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="17">[3,       8]  burst 3: +24</text><text x="16" y="144" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="17">[         8]  burst 8: +8</text><text x="16" y="182" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="17">Total: 15 + 120 + 24 + 8 = 167</text></svg>
visuals.caption: When 5 bursts, its neighbors are 3 and 8. The implicit boundary value is 1.
